task.title: Task reads answer from Git when the cache folder is read-only
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M96). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

With the cache folder read-only and no cache file in it, `workbook list` and `workbook show <task>` fail with "cannot create temporary projection cache". Relic reads in the same checkout answer from Git. This is behaviour on `main` for tasks. A read-only mount, or a folder owned by another user, is a likely setup for an agent in CI.

## Wanted

When the cache cannot be written, answer task reads from Git and say once, on stderr, that the cache is not in use.

## Done when

- `workbook list` and `workbook show <task>` answer in a checkout whose cache folder is read-only.
- The answer equals the one a writable checkout gives.
- A command that must write still fails with a clear message.

## Notes

Dylan agreed to this on 2026-11-26. The other half of the finding, a directory in the place of the cache file, is made by hand and is not part of this story.
